sources.title: AFI Catalog: Breakfast at Tiffany's (1961)
sources.access_method: Direct web open; inspected cast, adaptation and production history.
supports: Audrey Hepburn is credited as Holly Golightly.
The film is a Paramount feature adaptation of Truman Capote's 1958 novella.
Audrey Hepburn's casting as Holly was announced in trade reporting; Marilyn Monroe was among the performers considered.
limits: Casting consideration is not a finished-film credit.
The fictional character and narrative are not biographical history.

source_link.title: AFI Catalog: «Завтрак у Тиффани» (1961)
source_link.supports: Подтверждает Одри Хепбёрн — Холли Голайтли, экранизацию новеллы Трумена Капоте и историю кастинга.

sources.organisation: Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences
sources.title: Academy: The 34th Academy Awards (1962)
sources.access_method: Direct web open; inspected film-specific nominations and winners.
supports: The film had five nominations and two wins.
Henry Mancini won for the dramatic/comedy score, and Moon River won for song with music by Mancini and lyrics by Johnny Mercer.
Audrey Hepburn was nominated for Actress and George Axelrod for screenplay based on material from another medium.
limits: The ceremony page does not support a win claim for Hepburn's performance.

source_link.title: Academy: 34-я церемония «Оскара» (1962)
source_link.supports: Подтверждает пять номинаций, две музыкальные победы и номинации Хепбёрн и Аксельрода.

sources.title: AFI Catalog: Taxi Driver (1976)
sources.access_method: Direct web open; inspected cast, synopsis and production/awards history.
supports: Robert De Niro is credited as Travis Bickle.
The synopsis begins with 26-year-old Travis applying to be a New York City taxicab driver after Marine service.
AFI reports that De Niro drove a taxi while preparing, that the mirror line was improvised, and that the film received the 1976 Palme d'Or.
limits: The preparation and improvisation accounts are production history reported by AFI.
Travis is a fictional character, not a documented real taxi driver.

source_link.title: AFI Catalog: «Таксист» (1976)
source_link.supports: Подтверждает Роберт Де Ниро — Трэвис Бикл, завязку, подготовку актёра, импровизацию и «Золотую пальмовую ветвь».

sources.organisation: Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences
sources.title: Academy: The 49th Academy Awards (1977)
sources.access_method: Direct web open; inspected ceremony date, release-year statement and Taxi Driver nominations.
supports: The ceremony honors films released in 1976.
Taxi Driver is listed as a Best Picture nominee.
The page lists nominations for Jodie Foster in supporting actress and Bernard Herrmann's score.
limits: These are nominations, not Academy wins for Taxi Driver.
The page is an awards ledger and not evidence for plot details.

source_link.title: Academy: 49-я церемония «Оскара» (1977)
source_link.supports: Подтверждает, что церемония отмечала фильмы 1976 года, и номинации «Таксиста».

sources.title: AFI Catalog: All About Eve (1950)
sources.access_method: Direct web open; inspected cast, formal narration note and production-history note.
supports: Bette Davis is credited as Margo Channing.
Margo, Addison DeWitt and Karen Richards provide intermittent voice-over narration.
AFI reports Mankiewicz's interview account connecting the Margo archetype with eighteenth-century actor Peg Woffington.
limits: The Peg Woffington connection is reported interview context about an archetype, not a claim that Margo is a historical person.
The catalog credit establishes the film role, not an actor's personal identification with the character.

source_link.title: AFI Catalog: «Всё о Еве» (1950)
source_link.supports: Подтверждает Бетт Дэвис — Марго Ченнинг, чередование закадровых голосов и контекст образа Марго.

sources.organisation: Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences
sources.title: Academy: The 23rd Academy Awards (1951)
sources.access_method: Direct web open; inspected Best Motion Picture, Directing and costume-design results.
supports: All about Eve won Best Motion Picture.
Joseph L. Mankiewicz won Directing.
Edith Head and Charles LeMaire won black-and-white costume design for the film.
limits: This awards page does not identify Davis's character name.

source_link.title: Academy: 23-я церемония «Оскара» (1951)
source_link.supports: Подтверждает победы фильма за лучший фильм, режиссуру Джозефа Л. Манкевича и чёрно-белые костюмы.

sources.title: AFI Catalog: On the Waterfront (1954)
sources.access_method: Direct web open; inspected cast, synopsis, source history and research notes.
supports: Marlon Brando is credited as Terry Malloy, a former boxer working as a longshoreman in the synopsis.
Budd Schulberg based story and screenplay on Malcolm Johnson's 1948 New York Sun series about longshoremen and union corruption.
AFI says Schulberg also researched waterfronts with longshoremen and Father John Corridan and attended waterfront crime hearings.
limits: The fictional plot is inspired by reporting and research; it is not a biography of a documented Terry Malloy.
The source relationship does not establish that every film event happened in real life.

source_link.title: AFI Catalog: «В порту» (1954)
source_link.supports: Подтверждает Марлон Брандо — Терри Маллой, журналистский источник и исследование портовой среды Шульбергом.

sources.organisation: Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences
sources.title: Academy: On the Waterfront
sources.access_method: Direct web open; inspected premise, craft credits, locations and award record.
supports: The Academy describes Brando's Terry as a former prizefighter and longshoreman under a corrupt union boss.
It credits Schulberg's script, Bernstein's score, Kaufman's cinematography and Day's art direction, and notes shooting on both sides of the Hudson River.
The film received 12 nominations and eight wins, including Actor for Brando and Directing for Kazan.
limits: The Academy event description is a film overview; it should not be presented as a primary record of waterfront corruption.
Its awards summary concerns the awards recognizing the 1954 release.

source_link.title: Academy: «В порту»
source_link.supports: Подтверждает Брандо — Терри, творческие кредиты, натурные съёмки и восемь побед фильма, включая актёрскую Брандо.
